snippet.title: Bunraku | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Bunraku
Bunraku is a fast-paced fighting action game inspired by Japanese puppet theater. Master Dash and Parry in intense ninja battles for up to 8 players, local or online, across dynamic arenas, PvP modes, and team-based combat using powerful ninjutsu techniques.
